narrative.overview: The updater uses a light native Windows window, Korean system typography, and one emerald accent. The chosen workbook and version change receive the strongest emphasis before the user applies an update.
keyCharacteristics: A single window changes between selection, inspection, progress, completion, and error states.
Generous vertical spacing separates the task from its optional details.
One primary footer action stays visible while the content scrolls.
Status uses explicit text as well as color.
dos: Do keep the target workbook and version change visible before application.
Do use actual stage names and distinguish confirmed success from an uncertain save.
Do retain selectable details and full-path tooltips for longer values.
donts: Don't introduce a project sidebar, editor, or promotional artwork into this updater.
Don't replace explicit status text with color-only indicators or invented progress percentages.
